instruction: Make sure the text on the concluding slide is underlined.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires underlining all text in the final slide (slide 5, index 4). The evaluator uses a custom getter to extract the font underline status from ALL text runs in the slide and returns aggregate data (all_underlined, total_runs, underlined_runs). The metric verifies that all text runs are underlined by checking the all_underlined flag against the expected value of true. This ensures comprehensive verification of the entire slide's text.
